info.title: DevTrack API
info.description: Interactive DevTrack API. Sign in on the website in this browser, or execute POST /api/demo for an isolated sample workspace. Swagger automatically sends the session cookie and fetches a fresh CSRF token before protected changes. Requests modify the current account’s real data. Production documentation is disabled unless ENABLE_SWAGGER=true.

sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly session cookie managed by the browser. The served specification uses the actual cookie name for this launch mode. Do not paste cookie values into Swagger.

email.description: A personal email address. The demo.invalid domain is reserved for temporary demos.
